title: NGS 20/2024 – Draft Licenses, Regulations and Codes for the Natural Gas sector  – Statement of Results and Final Decision
text:
In this document, the Utilities Regulation and Competition Authority (“URCA”) issues its Statement of Results and Next Steps with respect to URCA’s Public Consultation on the Draft Licenses, Regulations and Codes for the Natural Gas sector.

URCA NGS 202024 – Regulatory Fees Methodology Consultation Document
